title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Protein Language Model Embeddings for Drug-Target Affinity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate identification of drug-target interactions is consequential for novel drug discovery and development. Deep learning methods for drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction have shown great promise in accelerating drug discovery and reducing development costs. Although graph neural networks have improved drug representation learning for DTA prediction tasks, many models still struggle to effectively and efficiently capture protein information, limiting overall prediction accuracy. In this work, we systematically evaluate the impact of pre-trained protein language models (PLMs) on the downstream task of predicting binding affinity between drugs and target proteins. We design multiple experiments across four different molecular representation backbones and assess the effect of incorporating PLM embeddings, comparing their performance to classical 1D convolution methods. We evaluate four families of PLMs which we integrate into PLM-GraphDTA, each built on distinct architectures and optimized for different tasks, including structure prediction, function prediction, and sequence unmasking. Additionally, we evaluate DeepGraphDTA, an architectural modification of the baseline convolution method designed to improve protein representation learning. The models are evaluated on two benchmark datasets, Davis and KIBA, using concordance index (CI) and mean squared error (MSE) as performance metrics. We further evaluate the generalization power of each model using cold-start train and test splits, and analyze the per-protein contribution to total CI. The results indicate simple architectural modifications to traditional convolution methods may be sufficient to bridge the gap to large pre-trained PLMs.
items.summary_zh: 系统比较多类预训练蛋白语言模型嵌入及改良卷积架构在药物—靶标亲和力预测中的作用，并在 Davis、KIBA 及冷启动划分上评估泛化表现。结果表明，传统卷积模型的简单架构改进可能已能缩小其与大型 PLM 的差距。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接检验蛋白表征是否真正改善 DTA 预测，对避免在药物发现中盲目叠加大模型具有参考价值。证据主要来自两个常用基准，真实项目中的靶点、化学空间和前瞻验证仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 准确识别药物—靶标相互作用对于新药发现和开发至关重要。药物—靶标亲和力（DTA）预测的深度学习方法在加速药物发现和降低开发成本方面展现出巨大前景。尽管图神经网络改进了 DTA 任务中的药物表征学习，许多模型仍难以有效且高效地捕获蛋白信息，从而限制整体预测准确性。在本工作中，我们系统评估预训练蛋白语言模型（PLM）对预测药物与靶蛋白结合亲和力这一下游任务的影响。我们在四种不同的分子表征骨干网络上设计多项实验，考察引入 PLM 嵌入的效果，并将其性能与经典的一维卷积方法进行比较。我们评估了四类 PLM，并将其整合至 PLM-GraphDTA；它们建立于不同架构并针对不同任务优化，包括结构预测、功能预测和序列掩码恢复。此外，我们还评估了 DeepGraphDTA，这是对基线卷积方法的架构修改，旨在改进蛋白表征学习。模型在两个基准数据集 Davis 和 KIBA 上接受评估，使用一致性指数（CI）和均方误差（MSE）作为性能指标。我们进一步使用冷启动训练和测试划分评估各模型的泛化能力，并分析每种蛋白对总 CI 的贡献。结果表明，对传统卷积方法进行简单的架构修改可能足以缩小其与大型预训练 PLM 之间的差距。

items.title: Machine Learning for High-Throughput Reaction Yield Prediction in DNA-Encoded Library Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: DNA-encoded library (DEL) synthesis relies on efficient DNA-compatible reactions to ensure library fidelity and the reliability of downstream affinity selection. However, most existing reaction yield prediction models were developed for general organic synthesis and typically use full-atom representations of complete reactants and products. In DEL single-cycle synthesis validation, an appropriate model reaction is to focus on the exposed reactive handle, its local chemical environment, the incoming building block (BB), and the reaction type, rather than large constant backgrounds such as the DNA tag, linker, and pre-existing scaffold. Here, we propose a functional-group-centric machine learning framework for DEL single-cycle reaction yield prediction. The model uses only the exposed substrate functional group (FG) and its coarse-grained local environment, the incoming BB, and the reaction type as inputs. Benchmarking on a real-world high-throughput DEL single-cycle validation dataset shows that graph neural network (GNN) models based on this localized representation outperform traditional fingerprint-based baselines, with a graph attention network (GAT) achieving the best overall performance and showing strong robustness on highly imbalanced industrial data. These results indicate that foregrounding the local reaction center is not merely a simplification of molecular representation, but a task-aligned strategy that better reflects the chemistry and decision logic of DEL single-cycle transformations. This lightweight framework is readily compatible with practical DEL workflows and provides valuable supports on reagent quality control (QC), building block selection, high-fidelity library design, and retrospective analysis of anomalous results.
items.summary_zh: 提出面向 DEL 单循环反应验证的官能团中心机器学习框架，仅以暴露反应官能团、局部环境、构件和反应类型为输入；在真实高通量数据上，局部表征的 GNN 优于指纹基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把反应中心从 DNA 标签、连接臂等恒定背景中分离出来，贴近 DEL 实际决策流程，可服务构件筛选和反应 QC。其适用范围目前集中于单循环 DEL 验证，跨反应体系和前瞻建库收益仍待确认。
items.abstract_zh: DNA 编码化合物库（DEL）合成依赖高效的 DNA 兼容反应，以确保文库保真度和后续亲和筛选的可靠性。然而，现有大多数反应产率预测模型是为一般有机合成开发的，通常使用完整反应物和产物的全原子表征。在 DEL 单循环合成验证中，合适的模型反应应聚焦于暴露的反应性官能团、其局部化学环境、进入的构件（BB）和反应类型，而非 DNA 标签、连接臂和既有骨架等大型恒定背景。在此，我们提出一种以官能团为中心的 DEL 单循环反应产率预测机器学习框架。模型仅使用暴露的底物官能团（FG）及其粗粒化局部环境、进入的 BB 和反应类型作为输入。在真实世界高通量 DEL 单循环验证数据集上的基准测试表明，基于该局部表征的图神经网络（GNN）模型优于传统指纹基线，其中图注意力网络（GAT）取得最佳总体性能，并在高度不平衡的工业数据上表现出很强稳健性。这些结果表明，突出局部反应中心不仅是对分子表征的简化，也是更能反映 DEL 单循环转化化学和决策逻辑的任务匹配策略。该轻量级框架易于兼容实际 DEL 工作流程，可为试剂质量控制（QC）、构件选择、高保真文库设计及异常结果回顾分析提供有价值的支持。
items.author_line: Tao Tang, Li Gao, Sen Gao, Hongyao Zhu, Guansai Liu, Jin Li, Xuemin Cheng

items.title: De novo design of ligand binding proteins using large language models alone
items.abstract_or_text: Protein design has rapidly advanced with the advent of sequence- and structure-based machine learning models. However, reasoned design, which applies physicochemical principles and rules derived from sequence-structure-function relationships, has not seen the same benefits from generative machine learning models. Here, we test the ability of common large language models (LLMs; e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini) to consider design principles to generate de novo proteins that bind metals and lipophilic small molecules without copying existing sequences. Common LLMs alone are able to 1) generate protein sequences to adopt a desired fold and bind the target ligand and 2) explain the principles that motivate the design choices. Following structure prediction and filtering, we selected a small set of designs (6 to 12 designs per query) for experimental validation, affording metal binders in one round of LLM-based design (25% hit rate) and perfluorooctanoic acid binders in two rounds (25% hit rate in the second round of design). Importantly, the LLMs produce detailed justification to accompany the de novo designed sequences, providing a conceptual framework on which designs can be evaluated. While the successful designs have some deviations from the prompted parameters and LLM-articulated design rationale, these campaigns provide a case study that highlights the utility of LLMs in making protein design more comprehensible and accessible to users without sophisticated design expertise.
items.summary_zh: 检验 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini 等通用 LLM 是否可仅依靠提示中的设计原则，从头生成结合金属或疏水小分子的蛋白；筛选后进行了实验验证，金属结合蛋白和 perfluorooctanoic acid 结合蛋白均报告 25% 命中率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作以湿实验把通用语言模型带入可解释的从头蛋白设计，降低了专业设计工具的使用门槛。实验规模很小，成功序列与提示参数及模型给出的设计理由存在偏差，不能据此推断稳定的通用设计能力。
items.abstract_zh: 随着基于序列和结构的机器学习模型出现，蛋白设计已快速发展。然而，运用从序列—结构—功能关系中获得的物理化学原理和规则的推理式设计，并未从生成式机器学习模型中获得同样的收益。在此，我们测试常见大语言模型（LLM；如 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Gemini）是否能够考虑设计原则，在不复制既有序列的情况下生成可结合金属和亲脂性小分子的从头蛋白。常见 LLM 单独即可 1）生成能采用所需折叠并结合目标配体的蛋白序列，且 2）解释驱动设计选择的原则。经结构预测和筛选后，我们选取少量设计方案（每个查询 6 至 12 个设计）进行实验验证，在一轮基于 LLM 的设计中获得金属结合蛋白（25% 命中率），并在两轮设计中获得 perfluorooctanoic acid 结合蛋白（第二轮设计中 25% 命中率）。重要的是，LLM 会为从头设计的序列给出详细论证，为评估这些设计提供概念框架。尽管成功设计与提示参数和 LLM 表述的设计原理存在一些偏差，这些设计活动提供了一个案例研究，凸显 LLM 可使不具备复杂设计专业知识的用户更容易理解和使用蛋白设计。
items.author_line: Kim, N. H., Hatstat, A. K., Jo, H., Wu, Y., DeGrado, W. F.

items.title: BiFuN: Machine Learning-Guided Bifunctional Catalysis in Hydrogenation Reactions
items.abstract_or_text: Hydrogen activation and further hydrogenation of substrate cover chemical processes in synthetic and energetic-related technologies. In homogeneous catalysis, transition metal complexes with bifunctional nature offer a platform for the activation and later utilization of the hydrogen-source. However, the development of new catalysts is limited by long-term trial-and-error practices. Screening approaches offer the possibility of relying on key properties to identify promising candidates. Here, we present a data-driven workflow that integrates high-throughput chemical screening, quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations, and machine learning (ML) predictions to accelerate the rational discovery of promising bifunctional catalysts (BFC). Using the Ru-MACHO scaffold as a BFC reference, we systematically explore metal complex variations across four design axes: 11 metal centers, 2,538 pincer ligands, 74 transligands, and 3 axial ligands, generating ca. 1.5M candidate structures. QM-derived data and ML models predict catalyst hydrogenation thermodynamics, enabling rapid identification of top-performing candidates for further mechanistic validation in CO2 hydrogenation. This integrated approach delivers prioritized systems for experimental follow up, demonstrating how curated datasets, targeted QM calculations, and ML together streamline the discovery of next generation homogeneous catalysts for efficient hydrogenation/dehydrogenation reactions.
items.summary_zh: BiFuN 将高通量化学筛选、QM 计算和 ML 预测结合，在 Ru-MACHO 骨架上沿四个设计维度枚举约 150 万个双功能催化剂候选，并以 CO2 氢化的热力学预测筛出可作机理验证的体系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该流程展示了用计算和机器学习缩小均相氢化催化剂搜索空间的可行路径，并明确给出较大规模的候选化学空间。现阶段优先级主要来自 QM 衍生数据和模型预测，具体候选的实验活性、选择性及耐久性仍是关键问题。
items.abstract_zh: 氢活化及后续底物氢化涵盖合成和能源相关技术中的化学过程。在均相催化中，具有双功能性质的过渡金属配合物为氢源的活化及后续利用提供了平台。然而，新催化剂的开发受限于长期的试错实践。筛选方法可依赖关键性质来识别有前景的候选物。在此，我们提出一个数据驱动工作流程，整合高通量化学筛选、量子力学（QM）计算和机器学习（ML）预测，以加速合理发现有前景的双功能催化剂（BFC）。以 Ru-MACHO 骨架作为 BFC 参照，我们沿四个设计维度系统探索金属配合物变体：11 个金属中心、2,538 个钳形配体、74 个 trans 配体和 3 个轴向配体，生成约 1.5M 个候选结构。QM 衍生数据和 ML 模型预测催化剂氢化热力学，使得能够快速识别表现最佳的候选物，以便在 CO2 氢化中开展进一步机理验证。这一整合方法提供了供实验跟进的优先体系，表明经整理的数据集、有针对性的 QM 计算和 ML 能共同简化下一代高效氢化/脱氢反应均相催化剂的发现。
items.author_line: Lucía Morán-González, Hannes Kneiding, Mohamed E. A. Safy, Matthias Beller, David Balcells, Ainara Nova

items.title: OptiMatLLM: A Benchmark Suite and a Lightweight Domain-Specific LLM for Optical Materials Research
items.abstract_or_text: The design of optical materials relies on highly specialized knowledge, which creates a major bottleneck for data-driven scientific discovery in the optical material domain. Large language models open new possibilities for scientific research, but general-purpose models struggle with the domainspecific physical logic and terminology. More importantly, no standardized evaluation benchmark exists to systematically assess how well LLMs perform on optical materials tasks. To fill this gap, we first construct two evaluation benchmarks, Optic_Choice and Optic_QA, designed specifically for the optical materials domain. We build a high-quality instruction-tuning dataset of 23,225 question-answer pairs through an automated multi-stage pipeline from a curated corpus of papers and textbook. We then develop OptiMatLLM, a 7-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned LLM on this corpus. Evaluation results show that OptiMatLLM achieves top performance on our optical benchmarks, reaching 0.79 accuracy on Optic_Choice, while also performing competitively on broader scientific tests such as CMHChem, ChemBench, and MaScQA. The model retains strong general capabilities as well, scoring 0.91 on the GSM8K mathematical reasoning benchmark. We further provide a systematic comparison of multiple leading models on these benchmarks, establishing a reference for future work. All benchmarks, dataset, and model are publicly released to support further research on LLMs for optical and optoelectronic materials design.
items.summary_zh: 构建光学材料领域基准 Optic_Choice、Optic_QA 及含 23,225 个问答对的指令微调数据集，并训练 7B 参数 OptiMatLLM；该模型在 Optic_Choice 上达到 0.79 准确率，相关资源已公开。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 公开基准、数据和模型为比较材料领域 LLM 提供了可复用起点，也把光学材料知识任务从泛化宣称转为可测量问题。数据自动构建过程、基准泄漏风险以及回答正确性与真实材料发现效用之间的差距仍需独立审查。
items.abstract_zh: 光学材料设计依赖高度专业化的知识，这为光学材料领域的数据驱动科学发现造成了主要瓶颈。大语言模型为科学研究开启了新可能，但通用模型难以掌握该领域特有的物理逻辑和术语。更重要的是，目前尚无标准化评估基准可系统评价 LLM 在光学材料任务上的表现。为填补这一空白，我们首先构建了两个专为光学材料领域设计的评估基准 Optic_Choice 和 Optic_QA。我们通过一个来自精选论文和教材语料库的自动化多阶段流程，构建了含 23,225 个问答对的高质量指令微调数据集。随后，我们开发了 OptiMatLLM，这是一个在该语料库上微调的 70 亿参数 LLM。评估结果表明，OptiMatLLM 在我们的光学基准上取得最佳性能，在 Optic_Choice 上达到 0.79 准确率，同时在 CMHChem、ChemBench 和 MaScQA 等更广泛科学测试中也具有竞争力。该模型还保留了强大的通用能力，在 GSM8K 数学推理基准上得分 0.91。我们进一步在这些基准上系统比较多个领先模型，为未来工作建立参照。所有基准、数据集和模型均已公开发布，以支持光学和光电材料设计的后续研究。
items.author_line: Xinyi Wang, Youle Wang, Lei Zhang

items.title: Deep drug design for molecular scaffold hopping
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-based virtual screening serves as a primary approach for ligand prioritization from large molecular libraries, but accurately predicting the activity of chemical entities on novel drug targets remains a formidable challenge. Here, we present an interactome-based graph transformer network for rapid bioactivity prediction and de novo ligand design. Integrating three-dimensional pocket geometry with two-dimensional ligand graphs yields a joint representation for direct affinity prediction, which generalizes well across sparse datasets. To validate practical utility, we performed a zero-shot generative ligand design to identify scaffold hops from the complex natural product ibogaine, a noncompetitive inhibitor of the serotonin transporter. The top-ranked design and its rational analogs were synthesized and exhibited equipotent isofunctional in vitro activity alongside favorable pharmacokinetic properties directly upon initial generation. This workflow establishes a blueprint for molecular engineering that seamlessly bridges the automated design of lead-like, synthetically accessible small molecules with efficient bioactivity prediction.
items.summary_zh: 提出融合三维结合口袋几何与二维配体图的 interactome 图 Transformer，用于亲和力预测和从头配体设计；针对 serotonin transporter 的 ibogaine 骨架跃迁设计经合成后显示等效体外活性和有利药代特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 零样本生成的候选物获得合成、体外活性和药代支持，使其比单纯虚拟筛选更接近真实先导化合物发现。验证聚焦单一复杂天然产物和靶点，跨靶点泛化、选择性及体内效应尚不明确。
items.abstract_zh: 基于结构的虚拟筛选是从大型分子文库中优先选择配体的主要方法，但准确预测化学实体在新药物靶点上的活性仍是一项艰巨挑战。在此，我们提出一种基于 interactome 的图 Transformer 网络，用于快速生物活性预测和从头配体设计。将三维口袋几何与二维配体图整合，得到用于直接亲和力预测的联合表征，该表征在稀疏数据集上具有良好泛化性。为验证实际效用，我们开展零样本生成式配体设计，从作为 serotonin transporter 非竞争性抑制剂的复杂天然产物 ibogaine 中识别骨架跃迁分子。排名最高的设计及其合理类似物被合成，并在初始生成后即表现出等效、同功能的体外活性以及有利的药代动力学性质。该工作流程为分子工程建立了蓝图，无缝衔接具有先导化合物性质、可合成小分子的自动化设计与高效生物活性预测。
items.author_line: Irene Pachon-Angona, Carl C. G. Schiebroek, Manuel G. Schriefer Treiber, Mattis Hilleke, Michael Iff, Achi Haider, Petra Schneider, Uwe Grether, Stephan Allenspach, Kenneth Atz, Gisbert Schneider

items.title: PolyGLOT: Graph-Token Language Modeling for Unified Polymer Property Prediction and Programmable Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer design benefits from representations that combine efficient sequence modeling with explicit access to molecular graph structure. String representations provide compact sequences but most remain sensitive to syntax and connectivity errors, whereas sequential graph generation becomes more costly as molecular graphs grow. We introduce PolyGLOT (Polymer Graph Language of Tokens), which represents a linear homopolymer repeat unit as a reconstructable sequence of mostly small molecular subgraphs. A graph encoder embeds each graph token, and a common Transformer backbone is pretrained by masked-token prediction and subsequently fine-tuned for property prediction or causal generation. PolyGLOT achieves competitive property-prediction performance while learning a hierarchy from local graph chemistry to context-dependent token states and property-organized polymer representations. Its attachment-constrained decoder produces valid repeat-unit graphs by construction, and the typically small token size makes local graph operations tractable. Beyond direct generation, the same graph-token interface supports expansion beyond the fixed vocabulary, property-guided local editing, required-substructure control, and small-molecule structural-precedent analysis. These results show that PolyGLOT provides a unified and extensible representation for polymer property prediction, generation, and downstream design.
items.summary_zh: PolyGLOT 以可重构的小分子子图序列表达线性均聚物重复单元，在统一 Transformer 中支持性质预测、因果生成、局部编辑、子结构约束和结构先例分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型试图同时保留序列建模效率和分子图连通性，面向聚合物生成时常见的语法与有效性问题给出结构化方案。摘要报告的是竞争性性能，尚缺少跨多类聚合物、合成可行性和实验性质验证的细节。
items.abstract_zh: 聚合物设计受益于能够结合高效序列建模与对分子图结构显式访问的表征。字符串表征提供紧凑序列，但多数仍易受语法和连通性错误影响；而随着分子图增大，序列式图生成的成本也会提高。我们引入 PolyGLOT（Polymer Graph Language of Tokens），它将线性均聚物重复单元表示为由大多较小的分子子图构成、可重构的序列。图编码器嵌入每个图 token，一个通用 Transformer 骨干通过掩码 token 预测进行预训练，随后针对性质预测或因果生成进行微调。PolyGLOT 在学习从局部图化学到依赖上下文的 token 状态、再到按性质组织的聚合物表征这一层级关系的同时，取得具有竞争力的性质预测性能。其带连接约束的解码器可按构造生成有效的重复单元图，而通常较小的 token 尺寸使局部图操作易于处理。除直接生成外，同一图 token 界面还支持超越固定词表的扩展、性质引导的局部编辑、所需子结构控制和小分子结构先例分析。这些结果表明，PolyGLOT 为聚合物性质预测、生成及下游设计提供了统一且可扩展的表征。

items.title: TAME: Element-wise Mixture-of-Experts Fusion for Data-Efficient and Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Property prediction for molecules and materials is bottlenecked by label scarcity, and in this regime the operative failure mode is not a low mean but an unpredictable tail: individual training runs collapse. The three dominant molecular representations fail in complementary ways—physicochemical descriptors are exact but fixed, graph neural networks learn topology but degenerate under sparse supervision, and language models supply semantic context but cannot compute exact quantities—yet combining them is itself the learning problem, because modality-level scalar gating commits the whole model to one trust weight per source. We introduce TAME, a tri-modal encoder whose element-wise Mixture-of-Experts router assigns an independent modality mixture to every hidden coordinate, stabilized by a balance–entropy regularizer, a closed-form gate initialization (β = log τ) that removes router burn-in, and two-stage self-supervised graph pretraining. On scaffold-split BACE (≈ 1.5k molecules, 100 seeds), the fusion stage improves level and spread together: median ROC-AUC rises from 0.752 to 0.817 and macro-F1 from 0.634 to 0.703, while seed-to-seed variance falls five-fold and a collapse tail reaching ROC-AUC ≈ 0.45 disappears. Because backbone, checkpoint, split, seeds and optimizer recipe are held fixed, the effect is attributable to the fusion stage alone. The router allocates a distinct mixture to each coordinate, which no scalar gate can represent, and the entropy weight moves that allocation continuously between graded mixing and a near-binary regime in which each coordinate is claimed outright by one modality. Gate mass additionally tracks encoder quality without supervision, shifting from text to topology once pretraining lifts the graph embedding out of rank-1 collapse. The same three experts map onto crystal graphs, composition–structure descriptors and literature-mined text, making TAME a transferable template for multimodal representation learning in materials discovery.
items.summary_zh: TAME 以逐元素 Mixture-of-Experts 融合分子描述符、图网络和语言模型表征；在 BACE scaffold split 的 100 个随机种子上，ROC-AUC 中位数由 0.752 升至 0.817，且训练方差降低。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将小数据分子建模中的稳定性作为核心评估目标，并用固定骨干、划分和训练配方隔离融合模块的作用。结果目前主要来自 BACE，广泛的材料迁移能力仍是基于表示对应关系的推断，需在独立任务中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子和材料的性质预测受标签稀缺制约；在这种情形下，实际的失败模式并非均值偏低，而是不可预测的尾部：单次训练会崩溃。三种主导性分子表征以互补方式失败——物理化学描述符精确但固定，图神经网络学习拓扑却会在稀疏监督下退化，语言模型提供语义上下文却无法计算精确量；但将它们组合本身就是学习问题，因为模态层面的标量门控会使整个模型为每个来源确定一个信任权重。我们引入 TAME，这是一种三模态编码器，其逐元素 Mixture-of-Experts 路由器为每个隐藏坐标分配独立的模态混合；该路由器由平衡—熵正则化、消除路由器预热的闭式门控初始化（β = log τ）和两阶段自监督图预训练稳定。在 scaffold-split BACE（约 1.5k 个分子，100 个随机种子）上，融合阶段同时提高水平和离散度：ROC-AUC 中位数从 0.752 升至 0.817，macro-F1 从 0.634 升至 0.703，而随机种子间方差降低五倍，ROC-AUC 约为 0.45 的崩溃尾部消失。由于骨干网络、检查点、划分、随机种子和优化器配方均保持固定，该效应可归因于融合阶段本身。路由器为每个坐标分配不同混合，这是任何标量门都无法表示的；熵权重可使该分配在渐进式混合与近二元机制间连续移动，在后者中每个坐标完全由一种模态占有。门控质量还可在无监督条件下追踪编码器质量：一旦预训练使图嵌入摆脱 rank-1 崩溃，门控质量便从文本转向拓扑。同样的三个专家可映射到晶体图、成分—结构描述符和文献挖掘文本，使 TAME 成为材料发现中多模态表征学习的可迁移模板。
items.author_line: Robert P. Schiller, Christoph Weisser, Klaus-Robert Müller, Christian Ochsenfeld, Parastoo Semnani

items.title: Reversible Site-Selective Editing of Atomically Precise Au6 Nanoclusters through Controlled Oxidative Addition/Reductive Elimination
items.abstract_or_text: Enacting precise bond formations and dissociations at specific sites is focal to molecular editing of functional materials but remains difficult to achieve on the surfaces of metal nanoparticles. Here, we demonstrate the first site-selective molecular editing of a multidentate ligand-stabilized [Au6(SbP3)2][PF6]2 (Au6) nanocluster (where, SbP3= tris(2-(diphenylphosphino)phenyl)stibine), using iodobenzene dichloride (PhICl2). Treatment of the parent Au6 cluster with PhICl2 leads to selective oxidative chlorination across one Au-Au bond, affording a new [Au6(SbP3)2Cl2][PF6]2 (Au6Cl2) nanocluster. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction of Au6Cl2 reveals a rearrangement of the parent Au6 core, with complete detachment of one gold atom from the core. Further, Au6Cl2 crystallizes as a racemic mixture, in contrast to the achiral parent cluster. The electronic structure and optical properties of the Au6Cl2 nanocluster was analyzed experimentally and theoretically, depicting good correlation. The Au6 to Au6Cl2 transformation is readily monitored by UV-visible absorption, NMR spectroscopy, and electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (ESI-MS). Remarkably, treatment of Au6Cl2 with sodium borohydride (NaBH4) regenerates the original Au6 cluster, establishing a reversible cluster transformation reaction. Taken together, this work illustrates how commonly used oxidizing and reducing reagents can be used to achieve site-specific, reversible structural editing of metal nanoclusters, providing a general strategy for tailoring their structural, optical, and chiroptical properties.
items.summary_zh: 利用 PhICl2 对 [Au6(SbP3)2][PF6]2 进行位点选择性氧化氯化，获得结构重排的 Au6Cl2；再经 NaBH4 可再生原始 Au6，形成可逆纳米团簇结构编辑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究以单晶衍射、光谱和理论分析展示金属纳米团簇的可逆位点编辑，为调控其结构与光学性质提供了精确化学手段。其结论目前建立于一个 Au6 平台，方法的底物普适性和功能器件中的实际增益尚待扩展。
items.abstract_zh: 在特定位点实现精确的成键和断键是功能材料分子编辑的核心，但在金属纳米颗粒表面仍难以实现。在此，我们展示首次对多齿配体稳定的 [Au6(SbP3)2][PF6]2（Au6）纳米团簇进行位点选择性分子编辑（其中 SbP3 = tris(2-(diphenylphosphino)phenyl)stibine），所用试剂为二氯碘苯（PhICl2）。母体 Au6 团簇与 PhICl2 反应，会在一根 Au-Au 键上发生选择性氧化氯化，生成新的 [Au6(SbP3)2Cl2][PF6]2（Au6Cl2）纳米团簇。Au6Cl2 的单晶 X 射线衍射揭示母体 Au6 核发生重排，一个金原子完全从核心脱离。此外，Au6Cl2 以外消旋混合物结晶，与非手性的母体团簇形成对比。我们通过实验和理论分析 Au6Cl2 纳米团簇的电子结构和光学性质，二者表现出良好一致性。Au6 向 Au6Cl2 的转化可由紫外—可见吸收、NMR 光谱和电喷雾电离质谱（ESI-MS）方便地监测。值得注意的是，以硼氢化钠（NaBH4）处理 Au6Cl2 可再生原始 Au6 团簇，建立可逆的团簇转化反应。总体而言，这项工作说明常用氧化剂和还原剂可用于金属纳米团簇的位点特异、可逆结构编辑，并为调控其结构、光学和手性光学性质提供通用策略。
items.author_line: R. W. U. Nethmini Ariyarathna, Elamparuthi Ramasamy, Paul Javed, Gayathri Habarakadage, Sayan Maiti, Nagaraju Vodnala, Maxime A. Siegler, Christine M. Aikens, Anindita Das

items.title: Unveiling Surface Reaction Networks in Biomass-Derived Compound Upgrading
items.abstract_or_text: Biomass-derived platform molecules often undergo complex surface reactions in which productive routes compete with catalyst deactivation, limiting catalyst selectivity and stability. Identifying the molecular origins of these competing processes remains challenging, as conventional computational approaches generally rely on chemical intuition and hypothesis-driven rules, while strongly adsorbed intermediates and poisoning species remain difficult to characterize experimentally. Here, we combine enhanced sampling reaction discovery techniques with machine learning interatomic potentials, experimental catalytic tests, and in situ DRIFTS to unravel the surface reaction network controlling methyl levulinate conversion on zirconia. Our simulations reveal a highly interconnected network of elementary transformations in which surface Lewis acidic Zr sites and basic oxides cooperatively promote carbonyl activation and α-deprotonation, giving rise to competing pathways toward cyclization and catalyst poisoning. This mechanistic picture is supported by experimental evidence, which reveal a progressive decrease in angelica-lactone formation and the accumulation of persistent carboxylate-like surface species. Our results show that the same cooperative acid base surface motif which activates the substrate and promotes productive cyclization, also induces irreversible surface trapping leading to catalyst poisoning. By revealing this intrinsic competition at the molecular level, our work provides a clue on how to steer zirconia reactivity toward selective biomass conversion while suppressing the formation of the persistent surface species responsible for deactivation. More broadly, our work establishes a general strategy to tackle complex reaction networks in heterogeneous catalysis.
items.summary_zh: 结合增强采样反应发现、机器学习原子间势、催化测试和原位 DRIFTS，解析 zirconia 上 methyl levulinate 转化的表面网络，揭示协同酸碱位点既促进环化也造成持久表面物种和失活。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 ML 势能面探索与原位实验对应，可用于处理异相催化中竞争路径和毒化物难以直接观测的问题。机理证据集中在 zirconia—methyl levulinate 体系，所提出的调控策略在其他生物质转化体系中仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生物质衍生平台分子常经历复杂表面反应，其中有效路径与催化剂失活相互竞争，限制催化剂选择性和稳定性。识别这些竞争过程的分子起源仍具挑战性，因为常规计算方法通常依赖化学直觉和假设驱动的规则，而强吸附中间体和毒化物种仍难以通过实验表征。在此，我们结合增强采样反应发现技术、机器学习原子间势、实验催化测试和原位 DRIFTS，解析控制 zirconia 上 methyl levulinate 转化的表面反应网络。我们的模拟揭示出一个高度互连的基元转化网络，其中表面 Lewis 酸性 Zr 位点和碱性氧化物协同促进羰基活化和 α-去质子化，从而产生通向环化和催化剂毒化的竞争路径。实验结果支持这一机理图景，显示 angelica-lactone 形成逐渐减少并积累持久的类羧酸盐表面物种。结果表明，同一协同酸碱表面基元既能活化底物并促进有效环化，也会诱导不可逆的表面捕获而导致催化剂中毒。通过在分子层面揭示这种内在竞争，我们的工作为如何将 zirconia 反应性导向选择性生物质转化、同时抑制导致失活的持久表面物种形成提供线索。更广泛而言，本工作建立了应对异相催化复杂反应网络的一般策略。
items.author_line: Fabio Loprete, Axel Tosello Gardini, Luca Visentin, Umberto Raucci, Lorenzo Mauro, Riccardo Tarroni, Fabrizio Cavani, Tommaso Tabanelli, Ivan Rivalta, Michele Parrinello

items.title: Retrieval of binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome using protein language model representations
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (PLMs) provide powerful representations of protein sequence, but their utility for proteome-scale binding-site retrieval remains unclear. Here, we present PocketScope, a training-free framework that represents cavity-lining residues using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings and retrieves related binding sites through exhaustive late-interaction MaxSim, without pooling or approximate nearest-neighbor search. PocketScope identified 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins in the AlphaFold human proteome and recovered documented drug off-targets across a curated set of pharmacological pairs. On the ProSPECCTs benchmark, PocketScope ranks 1st of 23 methods by mean rank across the ten collections. PocketScope provides a practical framework for proteome-scale off-target prediction. PocketScope is open source and also freely available as a web server at https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope.
items.summary_zh: PocketScope 以冻结的 ESM-C 600M 嵌入表示口袋衬里残基，用穷尽式 MaxSim 检索 AlphaFold 人类蛋白组中的相关结合位点；在 37,682 个蛋白中识别 153,805 个腔体，并在 ProSPECCTs 十个集合的平均排名中位居 23 种方法首位。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 蛋白组尺度的口袋相似性检索可为药物脱靶预测提供实用补充，并给出开源实现和网页服务。结果依赖 AlphaFold 结构和已整理药理配对，面对构象变化、隐蔽口袋及新化学型时的可靠性仍应审慎评估。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白语言模型（PLM）提供了强大的蛋白序列表征，但其在蛋白组尺度结合位点检索中的效用仍不清楚。在此，我们提出 PocketScope，这是一种无需训练的框架：它使用冻结的 ESM-C 600M 嵌入表征腔体衬里残基，并通过穷尽式后期交互 MaxSim 检索相关结合位点，不使用池化或近似最近邻搜索。PocketScope 在 AlphaFold 人类蛋白组的 37,682 个蛋白中识别出 153,805 个腔体，并在一组经整理的药理配对中找回已有文献记录的药物脱靶。在 ProSPECCTs 基准上，PocketScope 在十个集合的平均排名中位列 23 种方法的第 1 名。PocketScope 为蛋白组尺度脱靶预测提供了实用框架。PocketScope 已开源，也可通过 https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope 免费使用网页服务。

items.title: SimpleDesign: A Joint Model for Protein Sequence and Structure Codesign
items.abstract_or_text: Proteins are fundamental to biological processes, with their function determined by the complex interplay between the amino acid sequence and the three-dimensional structure. Developing generative models capable of understanding this intrinsically multi-modal relationship is crucial for fields like drug discovery and protein engineering. Existing models often rely on a multi-stage training process where autoencoders that tokenize data into latent representations are trained in a first stage. Secondly, a generative model is trained on the latent representation of the autoencoder(s), i.e., generative modeling in a latent space. We hypothesize that this multi-stage training is not necessary to obtain performant co-design models and thus present SimpleDesign, an effective multi-modal protein design model trained directly in the data space. SimpleDesign leverages a single-stage end-to-end objective that combines discrete cross-entropy for sequences and a regression objective for structures. In order to effectively model the difference in sequence and structure modalities, we develop a Mixture-of-Transformer architecture that allows modality-specific processing while keeping global self-attention over both modalities. We train SimpleDesign on over 2M sequence-structure pairs achieving strong performance across co-design and unconditional sequence/structure generation benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: SimpleDesign 以端到端单阶段目标联合建模蛋白序列和结构，采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 实现模态特异处理与跨模态全局自注意力，并在逾 200 万对序列—结构数据上训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型试图简化蛋白序列—结构协同设计常见的多阶段训练，适合比较生成式设计架构的效率与性能。摘要仅报告基准上的强表现，缺乏功能、稳定性或实验命中率等实验层面的支撑。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是生物过程的基础，其功能由氨基酸序列与三维结构之间复杂的相互作用决定。开发能够理解这种内在多模态关系的生成模型，对药物发现和蛋白工程等领域至关重要。现有模型通常依赖多阶段训练过程：第一阶段训练将数据 token 化为潜在表征的自编码器；第二阶段在自编码器的潜在表征上训练生成模型，即在潜在空间中进行生成建模。我们假设获得高性能协同设计模型并不需要这种多阶段训练，因此提出 SimpleDesign，一种直接在数据空间训练的有效多模态蛋白设计模型。SimpleDesign 利用单阶段端到端目标，将序列的离散交叉熵与结构的回归目标相结合。为有效建模序列和结构模态之间的差异，我们开发了 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构，使其能够进行模态特异处理，同时在两种模态上保留全局自注意力。我们在超过 200 万对序列—结构数据上训练 SimpleDesign，在协同设计以及无条件序列/结构生成基准上取得强劲表现。
items.author_line: Jiarui Lu, Yuyang Wang, Yizhe Zhang, Jiatao Gu, Navdeep Jaitly, Joshua M. Susskind, Miguel Ángel Bautista

items.title: Co-fluctuations of genes in single cells predict transcriptome-wide outcomes to perturbations
items.abstract_or_text: Pooled single-cell perturbation screens represent powerful experimental platforms for functional genomics, yet interpreting these rich datasets for meaningful biological conclusions remains challenging. Most current methods fall at one of two extremes: either opaque deep learning models that obscure biological meaning, or simplified frameworks that treat genes as isolated units. As such, these approaches overlook a crucial insight: gene co-fluctuations in unperturbed cellular states can be harnessed to model perturbation responses. Here we present CIPHER (Covariance Inference for Perturbation and High-dimensional Expression Response), a conceptual framework leveraging ideas from linear response in statistical physics to model transcriptome-wide perturbation outcomes using gene co-fluctuations in unperturbed cells. We validated our approach on synthetic regulatory networks before applying it to 29 large-scale single-cell genetic perturbation datasets covering 19,003 perturbations and over 6.26M cells. Our work robustly recapitulated genome-wide responses to single and double perturbations by exploiting baseline gene covariance structure. Importantly, eliminating gene-gene covariances, while retaining gene-intrinsic variances, i.e. mean-field conditions, dramatically reduced model performance by several folds across multiple metrics, demonstrating the rich information stored within baseline fluctuation structures. Benchmarked against recent deep learning and linear baselines, CIPHER matched or exceeded the best-performing approaches with fitting a single parameter. Moreover, gene-gene correlations transferred successfully across independent studies of the same cell type, revealing stereotypic fluctuation structures. We further extended CIPHER to the inverse problem of identifying true driver perturbations, where it achieved high performance across both genetic and chemical perturbation screens through uncertainty-aware Bayesian inference. We further used CIPHER to nominate drivers of therapy resistance in melanoma and pancreatic cancer, validating its top predictions experimentally. Finally, most genome-wide responses propagated through the covariance matrix along approximately 1-3 independent and global gene modules, consistent with a low-rank structure of the underlying gene regulatory network, which we show can enable the framework's success. We have also created a package called cipher-perturb, available on PyPI, to apply the framework to any dataset, accompanied by a detailed website (https://goyallab.github.io/CIPHERWebsite/). Our study underscores the importance of theoretically-grounded models in capturing complex biological responses, highlighting fundamental design principles encoded in cellular fluctuation patterns.
items.summary_zh: CIPHER 以统计物理的线性响应思想，从未扰动细胞的基因协方差推断扰动后的全转录组响应；在 29 个单细胞扰动数据集、19,003 种扰动和逾 626 万个细胞上测试，并实验验证了 melanoma 和 pancreatic cancer 耐药驱动因子预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作提出了具有理论可解释性的扰动响应模型，并在大规模遗传和化学扰动数据及实验验证中给出支持，可辅助靶点和耐药机制研究。协方差迁移的前提依赖相同细胞类型及数据条件，因果解释和临床外推不应超过现有证据。
items.abstract_zh: 汇集式单细胞扰动筛选是功能基因组学的强大实验平台，但要从这些丰富数据集中获得有意义的生物学结论仍具挑战性。当前多数方法处于两个极端之一：要么是不透明、掩盖生物学意义的深度学习模型，要么是将基因视为孤立单元的简化框架。因此，这些方法忽略了一个关键洞见：未扰动细胞状态中的基因共波动可用于建模扰动响应。在此，我们提出 CIPHER（Covariance Inference for Perturbation and High-dimensional Expression Response），这是一个概念框架，利用统计物理中线性响应的思想，通过未扰动细胞中的基因共波动来建模全转录组尺度的扰动结果。我们先在合成调控网络上验证该方法，随后将其应用于 29 个大型单细胞遗传扰动数据集，覆盖 19,003 种扰动和超过 6.26M 个细胞。我们的工作通过利用基线基因协方差结构，稳健地重现了单重和双重扰动的全基因组响应。重要的是，在保留基因内禀方差但去除基因—基因协方差的平均场条件下，多个指标上的模型性能大幅下降数倍，表明基线波动结构储存了丰富信息。与近期深度学习和线性基线相比，CIPHER 仅拟合一个参数便达到或超过最佳方法。基因—基因相关性还成功迁移至相同细胞类型的独立研究，揭示出固定的波动结构。我们进一步将 CIPHER 扩展至识别真实驱动扰动的逆问题，通过不确定性感知的 Bayesian inference，在遗传和化学扰动筛选中均取得高性能。我们还使用 CIPHER 提名 melanoma 和 pancreatic cancer 中治疗耐药性的驱动因子，并在实验中验证其最高预测结果。最后，大多数全基因组响应通过协方差矩阵沿约 1 至 3 个独立且全局的基因模块传播，这与潜在基因调控网络的低秩结构一致；我们表明该结构可使该框架成功。我们还创建了名为 cipher-perturb 的软件包，可在 PyPI 上获取，用于任何数据集，并配有详细网站（https://goyallab.github.io/CIPHERWebsite/）。本研究强调理论基础扎实的模型在捕获复杂生物响应中的重要性，并凸显细胞波动模式中编码的基本设计原则。
items.author_line: Kuznets-Speck, B., Kumari, N., Senthilkumar, I., Jung, J., Manuel Lopez Rios, H., Schwartz, L., Sun, H., Anisetti, V. R., Wang, C., Wang, Q., Pholraksa, P., Grody, E., Melzer, M. E., Haley, B., Prashnani, E., Li, J. J., Goyal, A., Vaikuntanathan, S., Goyal, Y.

items.title: Autonomous Homeostatic Synthetic Cells via Self-Gating DNA Nanopores
items.abstract_or_text: Homeostasis is a fundamental hallmark of living organisms, arising from the complex interplay between biochemical reactions and regulatory feedback systems. Reconstituting such self-regulating behaviour in minimal synthetic cells enables continuous, persistent operation of biochemical reactions for extended amount of time. In this work, we demonstrate a minimal homeostatic synthetic cell capable of autonomous flux regulation using DNA nanotechnology and bottom-up synthetic biology. Our homeostatic architecture consists of Giant Unilamellar Vesicles (GUVs) equipped with gated DNA nanopores, encapsulated in vitro transcription (IVT) machinery, and an RNA degradation system. We achieve homeostasis under varying external chemical stimuli specifically varying concentrations of rNTPs by implementing a negative feedback loop between rNTP influx and RNA production. In our system, DNA nanopores facilitate the influx of rNTPs from the external environment, driving internal transcription. Crucially, the transcription process generates RNA "blockers" designed to bind and gate the DNA nanopores, thereby attenuating further rNTP influx. Our system is dynamic as encapsulated RNases slowly degrade the RNA blockers, allowing the pores to reopen as blocker concentration goes down. We first characterise the functionality and gating efficiency of the DNA nanopores using both pre-synthesised and in situ produced DNA and RNA blockers. We then demonstrate that rNTP flux through these pores is sufficient to drive IVT within the GUVs. Finally, by integrating these modules, we demonstrate robust homeostasis: the system maintains a steady-state level of RNA production for up to 16 hours. By harnessing the controllability of negative feedback loop, we demonstrate thresholding of the homeostasis level using single-stranded regulator DNA. This work establishes a versatile framework for engineering adaptive and self-sustaining responsive nanomaterials and synthetic cell chassis.
items.summary_zh: 以带门控 DNA 纳米孔的 giant unilamellar vesicles、体外转录系统和 RNA 降解系统构建最小合成细胞；通过 rNTP 输入与 RNA 生成间的负反馈，在不同外部刺激下维持 RNA 生成稳态长达 16 小时。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将 DNA 纳米技术和自下而上的合成生物学结合，展示可自主维持通量的人工细胞原型，对响应性纳米材料和细胞底盘设计有启发。稳态时长和功能读出仍限于特定体外体系，复杂环境中的可扩展性有待考察。
items.abstract_zh: 稳态是生物体的基本特征，源于生化反应与调控反馈系统之间复杂的相互作用。在最小合成细胞中重建此类自调控行为，可使生化反应长时间持续运行。在本工作中，我们利用 DNA 纳米技术和自下而上的合成生物学，展示了一种能够自主调节通量的最小稳态合成细胞。我们的稳态架构由带门控 DNA 纳米孔的 giant unilamellar vesicles（GUVs）、封装的体外转录（IVT）机器和 RNA 降解系统组成。通过在 rNTP 内流与 RNA 生成之间实现负反馈环路，我们在变化的外部化学刺激下，特别是变化的 rNTP 浓度下实现稳态。在系统中，DNA 纳米孔促进外部环境中 rNTP 的内流，驱动内部转录。关键在于，转录过程产生被设计为结合并关闭 DNA 纳米孔的 RNA“阻断子”，从而减弱进一步的 rNTP 内流。该系统具有动态性，因为封装的 RNases 会缓慢降解 RNA 阻断子，使得随着阻断子浓度下降，孔道重新打开。我们首先使用预合成和原位生成的 DNA 与 RNA 阻断子，表征 DNA 纳米孔的功能和门控效率。随后，我们证明通过这些孔道的 rNTP 通量足以驱动 GUV 内的 IVT。最后，通过整合这些模块，我们展示了稳健的稳态：该系统可维持 RNA 生成的稳态水平长达 16 小时。借助负反馈环路的可控性，我们利用单链调控 DNA 展示了对稳态水平的阈值化调节。这项工作为构建适应性、自维持的响应性纳米材料和合成细胞底盘建立了多用途框架。
items.author_line: Bano, R., Marshall, Z., Howorka, S., Bae, W.

review.note: 从60项候选中选出15项。所选工作覆盖药物发现、催化与材料、蛋白与合成细胞，以及可复用的化学和生物模型方法；均为预印本，结论仍有待同行评议与更广泛复现。
